visualize_coco_predictions: run the script to visualize COCO dataset JSON predictions and save side-by-side images to an output directory
visualize_lvis_predictions: run the script to visualize LVIS dataset JSON predictions with confidence threshold filtering and save results
create_instances_from_predictions: create detectron2 Instances objects from raw prediction dictionaries with scores, bounding boxes, and segmentation masks
convert_bbox_format: convert bounding boxes from XYWH_ABS format to XYXY_ABS format using BoxMode for visualization
draw_instance_predictions: draw predicted instance annotations on images using Visualizer and concatenate with ground truth annotations
